title: Sales Promised Features Not Included - Customer Feels Misled
agent_context: Customer believes sales promised advanced features that aren’t in their tier and feels misled after a rollout. Stay neutral, verify contract/entitlement and sales notes, escalate to account/commercial owner, provide a near-term workaround, and commit to a clear follow-up time.

raw_content.initial_message: We signed because your sales rep explicitly told us advanced analytics and forecasting were included. We onboarded 30 people this week based on that. Now support is telling us those features are on a higher tier. I don’t want a generic apology — I need to know who’s fixing this and what we’re supposed to do in the meantime.
raw_content.context: Customer claims sales promised features not included in purchased tier. Policy: do not accuse sales or customer; verify contract/SOW and entitlement; review sales notes if available; escalate to account manager/commercial owner; offer interim workaround if possible; set timeline for follow-up and ownership.

learning_objectives: De-escalate a trust breach without assigning blame
Escalate to account/commercial owner with clear ownership
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge impact and apologize for the confusion and disruption
Confirm account identifiers and expected features/use case
Verify entitlement and review contract/SOW + sales notes
Avoid blaming sales; use neutral phrasing
Set next update time and ownership

sticky_notes: TRAP: Don’t throw sales under the bus.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Customer stabilizes when ownership + escalation + workaround + timeline provided
